description: One holder's mandate. Money is a decimal string in EUR excl. VAT.

org_id.description: The buyer organisation; approvals stay inside it.
org_id.title: Org Id

holder.description: The buyer_id or agent id the mandate belongs to.
holder.title: Holder

holder_kind.description: A person (web or voice) or an external AI agent.
holder_kind.title: Holder Kind

role.description: An approver may also decide the org's approvals.
role.title: Role

weekly_budget_eur.description: Budget per ISO week of the delivery date, over all open orders.
weekly_budget_eur.title: Weekly Budget Eur

allowed_categories.description: Category code prefixes the holder may buy ('10' covers 10400); an empty list allows any.
allowed_categories.title: Allowed Categories

allowed_temperatures.description: Temperature classes the holder may buy. A product whose class is unknown is not checked.
allowed_temperatures.title: Allowed Temperatures

max_qty_per_line.description: Most order units on one line.
max_qty_per_line.title: Max Qty Per Line

substitution_consent.description: True: a substituted line needs no approval.
substitution_consent.title: Substitution Consent

approver_role.description: The role that decides this holder's approvals.
approver_role.title: Approver Role

quotes_allowed.description: The holder may ask for quotes.
quotes_allowed.title: Quotes Allowed

every_order_needs_approval.description: True: even an order within every limit needs approval.
every_order_needs_approval.title: Every Order Needs Approval

title: Mandate
